from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.environment.environment_structure_builder import get_environment_structure_builder
from src.runtime.environment.environment_blueprint import EnvironmentBlueprint
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Environment_Structure(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_environment_structure"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("environment_name", "string", widget_type="text", default="western_room")
        self.add_input("blueprint_json",   "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_output("structure_json",        "string")
        self.add_output("structure_complete",    "bool")
        self.add_output("missing_required_json", "string")
        self.add_output("element_count",         "int")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        env_name = (inputs.get("environment_name") or "").strip()
        bp_json  = (inputs.get("blueprint_json") or "").strip()

        if not env_name:
            self.log_error("No environment_name provided.")
            return {"structure_json": "{}", "structure_complete": False, "missing_required_json": "[]", "element_count": 0, "exec_out": True}

        try:
            builder = get_environment_structure_builder()

            if bp_json:
                try:
                    bp_dict = json.loads(bp_json)
                    blueprint = EnvironmentBlueprint.from_dict(bp_dict)
                    plan = builder.build_structure(blueprint)
                except Exception:
                    plan = builder.build_environment(env_name)
            else:
                plan = builder.build_environment(env_name)

            status = "complete" if plan.structure_complete else f"incomplete — missing: {plan.missing_required}"
            self.log_info(f"Structure '{env_name}': {len(plan.elements)} elements, {status}")

            return {
                "structure_json":        json.dumps(plan.to_dict(), sort_keys=True, default=str),
                "structure_complete":    plan.structure_complete,
                "missing_required_json": json.dumps(plan.missing_required, default=str),
                "element_count":         len(plan.elements),
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Structure build failed: {exc}")
            return {"structure_json": "{}", "structure_complete": False, "missing_required_json": "[]", "element_count": 0, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Environment_Structure
